abstract: Install, serve, tune and troubleshoot KTransformers, the CPU+GPU hybrid inference stack (kt-kernel plus the sglang-kt fork and the kt CLI) for huge Mixture-of-Experts models. Covers pip and source installs, CPU backends (AMX, AVX512, AVX2, llamafile), native FP8, BF16 and RAWINT4 weights, AMX conversion, GGUF experts, the --kt-* flags, NUMA and thread sizing, expert placement, deferred experts, layerwise prefill, exposure and security. Includes a launch script, systemd unit and a DeepSeek-V4-Flash compose file. Verified against KTransformers v0.7.1.
